fusions.name: Buried Fact
fusions.desc: A heaving blow that deals 15 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dirt Spray
fusions.desc: Looses a narrow cone of earth that deals 4 damage to everything caught in it and has a 25% chance to leave each target [Blunted] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pit Marker
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to dig a pit trap that stays armed for 30 seconds. The first enemy to come within 2 tiles of it sets it off, and it deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 12 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
